title: Graded DCA run classification block
description: The run_classification object embedded in every run_state artifact. It is the single authoritative signal that distinguishes a scheduled live run of the repaired live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b) from an ad-hoc manual run so downstream slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never confuses the two. Contains no secrets.

run_origin.description: Authoritative origin of the run. 'scheduled' is reserved for the live cron task 10ce362c firing inside its window; everything else is 'manual'.

manual_run.description: true for manual runs, false for scheduled runs. Must agree with run_origin: manual_run === (run_origin == 'manual').

run_type.description: Free-form run type label. Scheduled live runs use 'scheduled_live_test'. Manual final-buy overrides (the 3:20 PM ET final-buy decision requested manually, e.g. the 2026-07-13 incident) use 'final_manual_buy_override' and MUST carry run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence=false, and same_day_top_up_context_only=true.

valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence.description: Whether this run counts as valid scheduled-afternoon execution evidence. Omitted/true for scheduled runs; MUST be false for run_type='final_manual_buy_override' so downstream slippage/watchdog/reliability/cost-basis reporting never treats a manual final override as scheduled evidence.

same_day_top_up_context_only.description: True for run_type='final_manual_buy_override' to mark its fills as same-day top-up / manual-override context only. Such fills appear only in the 'Manual Final Buy Override / Same-Day Top-Up Context' report section and never affect scheduled-live metrics.

cron_id.description: Live scheduled task id. Canonical value is '10ce362c' (the repaired live task; the deleted ce16ba6b is superseded). Placeholder or ambiguous values such as 'ce16ba6b_replacement' are forbidden. Carried on both scheduled and manual runs so manual runs can be attributed to the task they emulate.

supersedes_cron_id.description: Prior task id this run's task replaced, for lineage/continuity. Must be exactly 'ce16ba6b' (or null/omitted). Placeholder or ambiguous values such as 'ce16ba6b_replacement' are forbidden. This schema validates consumer acceptance/continuity: a scheduled run is accepted as valid evidence when cron_id='10ce362c' OR supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b' (see the anyOf below). The stricter writer contract — every newly written scheduled 3:20 PM ET run_state carries BOTH cron_id='10ce362c' AND supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b' — is enforced by the writer (scripts/run_classification.py) and documented in docs/run_classification.md, not by this schema.

scheduled_for_et.description: Nominal ET fire time of the scheduled task, HH:MM. '15:20' for scheduled runs; null/omitted for manual runs.

scheduled_window_start_et.description: Inclusive start of the accepted scheduled window in ET, HH:MM ('15:15').

scheduled_window_end_et.description: Inclusive end of the accepted scheduled window in ET, HH:MM ('15:35').

run_id.description: Unique run id. Scheduled: 'scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET'. Manual: a distinct id, e.g. 'manual_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSSZ', that never collides with the scheduled pattern.

triggered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run was triggered.

state_schema_version.description: Version tag of the run-classification contract. 'run-classification-v1' is the original; 'run-classification-v2-preauthorized' is the stricter successor introduced 2026-07-10 for the pre-authorized direct-placement live task (no review_equity_order). Both are accepted as valid scheduled/manual evidence when the required scheduled identity fields (run_origin, manual_run, cron_id/supersedes_cron_id, scheduled_for_et, window, run_id) are correct; v2 is a stricter successor of v1, not a different contract.
